title: Auth Control Plane authorization batch response (v1 wire format)
description:
The answer to one authorization_batch_request.v1. Each item is an independent authorization_decision.v1 bound to its request by `index`, the zero-based position of the request in the batch.

THE FAILURE THIS PREVENTS: one item's allow read against another item's resource. The binding is explicit (`index`) as well as positional so a proxy that reorders or drops items is detectable. What the SCHEMA cannot say: that the number of decisions equals the number of requests, and that index N answers request N. Those compare TWO documents, so they are client-enforced and pinned by the reject_by_client fixtures (a response with fewer or more decisions than the request, a swapped, duplicated or skipped index). A client MUST refuse such a response entirely and deny every item: it must never use the items that happen to line up.

A failure of the whole batch is an error.v1 document, not a batch response. `index` is bounded to the same 0..99 range as the request's item bound.

index.description: Zero-based position of the request this decision answers.
